scenario.limitations: Weights and thresholds are explicitly arbitrary governance design assumptions; this is not Norges Bank's model.

hypothesis: An unchanged policy rate can coexist with changing macro risks; board triggers should depend on risk limits, not the rate headline.
alternative: The policy decision includes FX, labour market and energy shocks; a single inflation reading is not sufficient.
falsifier: Backtesting of firm-level risk triggers shows no material incremental value beyond existing risk limits.
